events.verdict: Boston Jr. (NOP) establishes himself in Williams' (BKN) path and does not deliver illegal contact as he sets the pick on the perimeter.
Williams (BKN) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to momentarily dislodge it from Boston Jr.'s (NOP) possession.

Missi (NOP) is the secondary defender on a drive that starts outside of the LDB and is positioned inside the restricted area when the contact with Johnson (BKN) occurs during his driving shot attempt.
Murphy III (NOP) inadvertently steps on Williams' (BKN) foot on the perimeter and the contact is incidental.
Green (NOP) legally contests Thomas's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Williams (BKN) is in a legal guarding position defending Ingram's (NOP) drive to the basket when Ingram veers into him to initiate the marginal contact.
Murphy III (NOP) commits a take foul on Schroder (BKN).
Boston Jr (NOP) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Thomas (BKN).
As Thomas (BKN) secures the rebound, Boston Jr. (NOP) gets his hand on the ball and any contact between the two players is incidental. A held ball is then whistled.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Nets (BKN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Missi (NOP) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and Brookyn is given possession when play resumes.
